## @stolyarovmn/dsh-client-ui-schedule-tab 0.6.0

Requires DeepSeek Harness `0.1.7-rc.2` exactly.

### Changes

- Uses the native Host-wide Schedule catalog.
- Enhances the native Automation tasks sidebar and main panel without adding a second Schedule entry.
- Adds task search, filters, grouping, recurrence display, unread/overdue indicators, and delivery history.
- Adds in-place editing for Once, Every, Daily, Monday-to-Friday, Weekly, and Cron rules.
- Uses native Schedule update and delete operations.
- Opens the source Session and native task detail from task cards.
- Refreshes the catalog on Schedule changes and connection resets.
- Enables the required native `time-context`, `schedule`, and `ui-schedule` rows through the bundle patch.

### Install

```bash
pnpm dlx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.7-rc.2 plugin --profile web add @stolyarovmn/dsh-client-ui-schedule-tab@0.6.0
```

For pre-rc2 DSH releases, use `@stolyarovmn/dsh-client-ui-schedule-tab@0.5.1`.
